# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  Baseline profile — AOT-compile the startup path instead of interpreting it.
#
#  On a Wear device this is the single biggest cold-start lever available. Every
#  class listed here is compiled ahead of time by the profile installer on first
#  run, so opening the app does not pay JIT warm-up for the schedule render.
#
#  HONEST CAVEAT: this is hand-written from the known startup path, not captured
#  from a real device run. A profile generated by the Baseline Profile Gradle
#  Plugin against a Galaxy Watch 6 would be strictly better, because it records
#  the actual methods executed in the actual order. Doing that needs a
#  :benchmark module and a connected device, so it is the natural follow-up. The
#  wildcards below are deliberately broad: over-including costs a little dex
#  compile time at install, under-including costs frames on every launch.
#
#  Format: HRF. H = hot, S = startup, P = post-startup.
#  Docs: https://developer.android.com/topic/performance/baselineprofiles
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── The app itself: every class on the path to first frame ──────────────────
HSPLcom/spedatox/ultroncore/UltronWear;->**(**)**
HSPLcom/spedatox/ultroncore/design/**->**(**)**
HSPLcom/spedatox/ultroncore/data/**->**(**)**
HSPLcom/spedatox/ultroncore/presentation/**->**(**)**
HSPLcom/spedatox/ultroncore/presentation/components/**->**(**)**

# The theme engine's HSL round-trip runs once, at first composition, on the main
# thread. Small, but it is squarely on the critical path.
HSPLcom/spedatox/ultroncore/design/ColorMath;->**(**)**
HSPLcom/spedatox/ultroncore/design/ThemeEngine;->**(**)**

# ── Compose runtime: composition, snapshots, recomposition ──────────────────
HSPLandroidx/compose/runtime/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/runtime/snapshots/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/runtime/collection/**->**(**)**

# ── Compose UI: layout, draw, modifiers, text ───────────────────────────────
HSPLandroidx/compose/ui/node/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/ui/layout/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/ui/graphics/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/ui/draw/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/ui/text/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/ui/unit/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/ui/platform/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/ui/Modifier**->**(**)**

# ── Foundation: the lazy list is the most allocation-heavy thing we run ─────
HSPLandroidx/compose/foundation/lazy/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/foundation/layout/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/foundation/gestures/**->**(**)**

# ── Wear Compose: scaling list + M3 scaffolding ─────────────────────────────
HSPLandroidx/wear/compose/foundation/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/wear/compose/material3/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/wear/compose/navigation/**->**(**)**

# ── Kotlin coroutines + serialization: schedule load happens during startup ──
HSPLkotlinx/coroutines/**->**(**)**
HSPLkotlinx/serialization/json/**->**(**)**
